guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low (asynchronous reset), rx_val_q is set to 16'h0.
When tick_baud_x16 is high and not in reset, rx_val_q is left-shifted by 1 position and the new LSB is assigned rx_in.
When tick_baud_x16 is low and not in reset, rx_val_q retains its previous value.

assumptions.claim: tick_baud_x16 must be a single-cycle pulse synchronous to clk_i; it must not remain high for multiple consecutive cycles.
assumptions.risk: If tick_baud_x16 stays high for multiple cycles, rx_val_q will oversample rx_in multiple times per baud interval, corrupting the captured bit stream and leading to framing errors.

assumptions.claim: rx_in must be stable when tick_baud_x16 is asserted, or its value must be synchronized externally to avoid metastability.
assumptions.risk: If rx_in changes near the sampling edge, a metastable value may be captured in rx_val_q, leading to indeterminate bits and potential UART data corruption.
